notes: ἀπὸ τότε is split rather than joined, the ASV having written separate English words (rule 94).
Heading τότε's unit on *that* rather than *time* remains defensible under rule 17's generic-noun reasoning; *time* is taken as the nominal anchor on the tie-breaking clause of the same rule.
ἤγγικεν heads on *hand*, the frame's meaning-bearing word, as the corpus heads ἐγγύς → *at hand* (rules 17, 71, 91).
τῶν is unrepresented, the ASV giving *heaven* no determiner and the case preposition staying with the noun (rules 21, 23).
